- SOC 2 Type II: We have a Type II report that covers the audit period 2024-03-01 to 2025-02-28 (most recent). If your procurement requires calendar-year 2024 specifically, we can provide a bridge letter that documents the scope and controls continuity; see options below.

Julia / team — adding a quick note on bridge-letter options. We typically offer two variants:

A) Scope-affirmation bridge letter (no attestation): states audit period covered by current report and confirms that key controls and system boundaries remained materially unchanged during the missing calendar window. Good for procurement teams that need continuity context but don’t require a signed attestation.

B) CPA-signed bridge letter addendum: a short letter signed by our auditor that references the latest Type II and summarizes any differences in scope or control changes. This is stronger but requires auditor coordination (turnaround ~5–7 business days).

For evidence intake we recommend starting with the attached spreadsheet. Grace — can you confirm the owner for Identity & Access controls and provide a couple of sample artifacts (access review screenshot, onboarding checklist)?

-Karthik
